author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000282293 (PTHR12521)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Targ1/2/3 (FBgn0053054/FBgn0053056/FBgn0085290) and orthologs

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source

This node is annotated with ADP-ribosyl-[dinitrogen reductase] hydrolase activity (GO:0047407) based on a single annotation to yeast POA1 from PMID:23474712 by SGD. This is a subtype of GO:0003875 ADP-ribosylarginine-[protein] hydrolase activity.

However, that yeast annotation looks wrong - Fig 4d says "Quantification of macrodomain proteins' demodification activity on [32P]ADP-ribosylated PARP10." and earlier statement in paper is "PARP10, which adds single ADPr units onto **glutamate** residues" (which includes automodification) => should be "GO:0140293 ADP-ribosylglutamate-[protein] hydrolase activity"

Furthermore, we just decided to obsolete GO:0047407 - see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31850.
title: PAINT issue: PTN000282293 (PTHR12521)
